check_duplicate_pr: Check if an open PR already exists for this specific error. Returns DUPLICATE (with PR URL) or NO_DUPLICATE. Input: {error_type: string, service: string, description_prefix: string (first 100 chars of description)}
get_occurrence_count: Count how many times an error pattern appeared in CloudWatch logs over the last N hours. Use hours=24 for blast radius / severity assessment. Input: {log_group: string, pattern: string, hours: integer (default 24)}
